prompt.zh-TW: 木岸家具今年營業毛利 {{money:vars.gp}}、營業利益 {{money:vars.oi}}，營運槓桿度是 {{number:vars.dol|digits=2,unit=times}}（見上表）。如果明年營收成長 {{percent:vars.growth}}、其他條件不變，下列哪一個推論正確？
prompt.en: Woodbank Furniture had gross profit of {{money:vars.gp}} and operating profit of {{money:vars.oi}} this year, a degree of operating leverage of {{number:vars.dol|digits=2,unit=times}} (see the table above). If revenue grows by {{percent:vars.growth}} next year and nothing else changes, which conclusion is correct?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。槓桿度放大的是百分比：營收的變動百分比乘以槓桿度，就是營業利益的變動百分比。
feedback.en: That’s right. Leverage magnifies percentages: the percentage change in revenue times the degree of leverage gives the percentage change in operating profit.

text.zh-TW: 營收每多 {{money:vars.revStep}}，營業利益就多 {{money:vars.profitStep}}
text.en: For every extra {{money:vars.revStep}} of revenue, operating profit rises by {{money:vars.profitStep}}

feedback.zh-TW: 你抓到「營業利益變動比營收大」這個方向，這點對。不過槓桿度放大的是變動的「百分比」，不是金額；營業利益不可能比多出來的營收還多。課程有些例子用金額說明槓桿度；網站統一用百分比解讀，因為槓桿度的定義就是兩個變動百分比相除。
feedback.en: You got the direction right: operating profit moves more than revenue. But leverage magnifies the percentage change, not the amount; operating profit cannot rise by more than the extra revenue itself. Some course examples explain leverage in amounts; the site always reads it in percentages, because leverage is defined as one percentage change divided by another.

text.zh-TW: 營業利益也剛好成長 {{percent:vars.growth}}，因為成本會等比例增加
text.en: Operating profit also grows by exactly {{percent:vars.growth}}, because costs rise in proportion

feedback.zh-TW: 如果所有成本都隨營收等比例變動，槓桿度會是 {{number:1|digits=0,unit=times}}；木岸家具的槓桿度大於 {{number:1|digits=0,unit=times}}，表示有固定費用，營業利益的變動比例會比營收大。
feedback.en: If every cost moved in proportion to revenue the degree of leverage would be {{number:1|digits=0,unit=times}}; Woodbank’s is above {{number:1|digits=0,unit=times}}, which means there are fixed costs and operating profit moves proportionally more than revenue.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_tspyazrx}}回答「營收變動 {{percent:0.01|digits=0}}，營業利益變動百分之幾」。{{option:o_67j6}}用百分比正確放大；{{option:o_3qz5}}誤用金額，{{option:o_y5d3}}等於假設沒有固定費用。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_tspyazrx}} answers ‘by what percentage does operating profit change when revenue changes by {{percent:0.01|digits=0}}’. {{option:o_67j6}} magnifies the percentage correctly; {{option:o_3qz5}} wrongly uses amounts, and {{option:o_y5d3}} amounts to assuming there are no fixed costs.
